nodes.summary: For a finite word $d_1 d_2 \cdots d_k$ of direction labels in $\{0, 1, 2\}$, its endpoint is the vertex reached from the origin by taking the step in direction $d_1$, then the step in direction $d_2$, and so on through $d_k$. The endpoint of the empty word is the origin.
nodes.title: Endpoint of a direction word

nodes.summary: Let $c_n$ be the number of $n$-step self-avoiding walks on the honeycomb lattice starting at the origin. Then $c_n^{1/n} \to \sqrt{2 + \sqrt{2}}$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: The connective constant of the honeycomb lattice

nodes.summary: A vertex of the honeycomb lattice is a triple $(x, y, s)$ with $x, y \in \mathbb{Z}$ and $s$ a boolean recording which of the two classes of the bipartition the vertex belongs to.
nodes.title: Vertices of the honeycomb lattice

nodes.summary: A word $(d_1, \ldots, d_n)$ of direction labels in $\{0, 1, 2\}$ is self-avoiding when its set of visited vertices has exactly $n + 1$ elements, that is, when its $n + 1$ vertices, the $i$-th vertices for $0 \le i \le n$, are pairwise distinct.
nodes.title: Self-avoiding direction words

nodes.summary: For every vertex $v$ of the honeycomb lattice, the steps from $v$ in the directions $0$, $1$ and $2$ are three distinct vertices.
nodes.title: Distinct labels give distinct neighbors

nodes.summary: For every vertex $v$ of the honeycomb lattice and every direction label $d \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, taking the step in direction $d$ from $v$ and then the step in direction $d$ again returns to $v$.
nodes.title: Steps are involutions

nodes.summary: For a vertex $v = (x, y, s)$ and a direction label $d \in \{0, 1, 2\}$, the step from $v$ in direction $d$ is a vertex on the other side of the bipartition. If $s$ is true, it is $(x, y, \mathrm{false})$, $(x + 1, y, \mathrm{false})$ or $(x, y + 1, \mathrm{false})$ for $d = 0, 1, 2$ respectively. If $s$ is false, it is $(x, y, \mathrm{true})$, $(x - 1, y, \mathrm{true})$ or $(x, y - 1, \mathrm{true})$ for…
nodes.title: Steps in the honeycomb lattice

nodes.summary: For a word $(d_1, \ldots, d_n)$ of direction labels in $\{0, 1, 2\}$ and an integer $0 \le i \le n$, the $i$-th vertex of the word is the endpoint of its prefix $(d_1, \ldots, d_i)$, the vertex reached from the origin after the first $i$ steps.
nodes.title: Vertices along a direction word

nodes.summary: For a word $(d_1, \ldots, d_n)$ of direction labels in $\{0, 1, 2\}$, the set of visited vertices is the finite set of its $i$-th vertices for $0 \le i \le n$; it contains the origin (for $i = 0$) and the endpoint of the word.
nodes.title: Vertices visited by a direction word

nodes.summary: There are exactly $90$ self-avoiding walks with $6$ steps on the honeycomb lattice starting at a fixed vertex.
nodes.title: Six-step self-avoiding walks on the honeycomb lattice

nodes.summary: There are exactly $12$ self-avoiding walks with $3$ steps on the honeycomb lattice starting at a fixed vertex.
nodes.title: Three-step self-avoiding walks on the honeycomb lattice

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, this is the number of self-avoiding walks with $n$ steps on the honeycomb lattice starting at the origin.
nodes.title: Number of self-avoiding walks on the honeycomb lattice

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
